max_physical_networks.description: Maximum number of physical networks that can be managed by the SR-IOV agent.

physnets.description: List of physical network interfaces to be used by the SR-IOV agent. Each entry maps a physical network name to a network interface.

pci_passthrough_whitelist.description: List of PCI device addresses (in domain:bus:device:function format) to be managed by the SR-IOV agent. Required for assigning SR-IOV VFs to instances.

debug.description: Enable debug logging for detailed diagnostics.

log_dir.description: Directory where the agent log files are stored.

log_file.description: Name of the log file (relative to log_dir).

interface_driver.description: Interface driver to use for managing network interfaces. Common values: neutron.agent.linux.interface.OVSInterfaceDriver or neutron.agent.linux.interface.BridgeInterfaceDriver.

device_driver.description: Kernel driver used for VF devices (e.g., vfio-pci). Optional; leave blank to use the system default.

polling_interval.description: Interval (in seconds) between VF link state polling checks.

use_netlink.description: Use the netlink interface instead of sysfs for improved VF management performance.

workers.description: Number of worker processes to handle RPC and device events. Use more workers for higher throughput.
